data.one_liner: Exposes the POSIX api on OSx and Linux via an idiomatic Dart API.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart access to the POSIX API for macOS and Linux systems using FFI. It translates C types to Dart types and throws PosixException on errors instead of returning error codes.
use_when: You need to access POSIX system APIs on macOS or Linux from Dart
You want idiomatic Dart functions and exceptions instead of raw FFI bindings
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than macOS and Linux
You do not want native dependencies or FFI setup
strengths: Translates C types to idiomatic Dart types
Modern error handling using exceptions rather than error codes
weaknesses: Limited to macOS and Linux platforms
Requires platform-specific native libraries and ffigen for development
data.setup_notes: Requires libclang-dev and running ffigen to generate or update bindings.
